heuristics.statement: The Pollard rho iteration on order-6 automorphism equivalence classes (canonical representative, class-invariant partition into 2^16 adding points) behaves as a uniform random mapping on the N'' = 1 + (r-1)/6 classes for collision statistics; visited classes before any repeat are modelled as independent uniform samples.
heuristics.support: Standard heuristic for Pollard rho analyses (Pollard 1978; van Oorschot-Wiener 1999; negation/GLV class variants after Wiener-Zuccherato). Empirically supported at toy scale by the included experiment toy-rho-glv and its negation configuration: visited-class collision means and budget success rates match the birthday model at the stated scope (proof.md Section 8).

limitations: Analytic construction; no full-size execution or independent qualification.
Success probability 0.43 is conditional on the disclosed random-mapping heuristic H1; all other steps are exact.
The declared exponential memory (2^113 bytes) is required; this is not a practical break of secp256k1.
Per-step instruction bounds are analytical upper bounds in the cost model's scalar AArch64 instruction basis, not measurements of an implementation.
